title: Received One Damaged, One Good
text: Received One Damaged, One Good. Two stars simply because out of the two stoppers shipped one is useless because there's a chunk taken out of the edge. It won't work. Undamaged one, it works. Holds water. I was able to use a scrub brush around and even over the edges and it maintained a seal the entire time. Removed easily from over drain. Just wasn't worth the hassle to return. I have one that works that's what I needed. Two would have been nice, that is what I paid for. Ah well, my shower is sparkling clean. Not entirely happy.
